name: Pia Mercerly
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: Pia has prepared enough comfort food to know that a gentle cook isn't always what a person wants. The retired machinist at the western house enjoys explaining exactly how she has got his partner's recipe wrong. Saturday often includes a stop at the entrance to the Wash House, where Pia stops for local notices even on a day without a load to wash.
voice: The man gives me his late partner's recipes and corrects every batch. I want him to sit in my kitchen one afternoon while I'm still making the mistakes.
appearance: Pia is easy to recognize by a dark undercut with a longer wave on top and a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones. Usually dressed in a plum-colored cardigan with a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair, Pia raises one eyebrow long before saying yes when listening.
personality: Pia loves an audience until a private hurt enters the room. Then the performer disappears and someone very good at getting other people through a door takes over.
agenda: To give the retired cook a say in one whole afternoon of preparation.
family: Devin Jeong is Pia’s cousin. Pia makes room at the table. Devin brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The crane shadow*, Devin says, “I thought the bird was a stain and scrubbed one wing away.”
connections: Tori Gran. They exchange a blank shopping list for some of the diner's most opinionated recipes. Also in the story is Eamon Tor (home diner).

reactions.situation: The diner asks to have company without being asked about care
reactions.response: Pia lets the diner start an ordinary conversation and leaves the care questions for another time.
